notes.title: NEURODIVER Soundtrack, Artbook, and FREE Manual incoming!
notes.content:
Hi ROM fans!
We're excited to announce that alongside the release of Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER on May 16th, we will be launching an artbook, an original soundtrack, and a FREE digital manual on the same day.

[h2]Visual Works[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/f98eae53516c6b6d943a2ac37a3ae87af71861b4.png[/img]
Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER is a beautiful homage to anime-inspired classic Japanese adventure games such as Famicom Detective Club, Snatcher, and Policenauts. 

To showcase the artwork in NEURODIVER, "Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER Visual Works" dives into concepts, designs, key art, animation frames, and much more from the game. Compiled by MidBoss' creative director and lead artist, John "JJSignal" James, this collection is a must-have for fans curious about peeking behind the scenes at the visuals that would eventually paint the the pixelated world of Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER! 

[h2]Original Game Sountrack[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/37efcc751e91e4ba6c32de28150228c3d2c43f31.png[/img]
Dive into the bright, glossy and rich tones of Neo-San Francisco with 22 original tracks composed by Ken "coda" Snyder.

Let the silicon streets of the city come to life in your ears as each song sets the hearts of classic Yamaha FM chips on FIRE!

It's a PSY-FI HI-FI SOUND SENSATION!!

Long live the power of FM synthesis!

[h2]Instruction Manual[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/3593df76d00be3ed4391201dc24c6f208abddb60.png[/img]
Step back into the golden era of gaming when every game came with a manual!

This Digital Game Manual doesn't just show you how to play the game, but provides beautiful and detailed info about the world of Neo-San Francisco in 2070. Learn about the mysterious MINERVA, meet ES88 and her friends and colleagues, and reunite with old friends like Turing.

Extras include concept art and animation frames - all for FREE!

[h2]Complete Edition Bundle[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/6bcbfe96cf57ce4bd168bb93c90ef11d20c166d5.png[/img]
The complete collection - game, artbook, soundtrack, manual - will be available as a Complete Your Collection Bundle on Steam.

If you haven't already, please Wishlist the game now and get ready to dive into the neon pixel world of Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER on May 16th!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement for Read Only Memories NEURODIVER!
notes.content:
Kept you waiting, huh?

[previewyoutube=-ljJbTUUfBA;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][i]May 16th, 2024 A.D.[/i][/b] marks the launch of Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293910/Read_Only_Memories_NEURODIVER/]Steam[/url], Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/162fb05f943f1e9326547686a72a4f3ced8c2f33.png[/img]
That's right, you saw it here first ([i]maybe[/i])! Join ES88 as she hunts down the elusive psychic entity, Golden Butterfly, on [b]May 16th[/b]! We've had many release windows in the past, all of which we'll admit were pretty ambitious, but this is it! We can't miss it! It's set in stone! That stone is really, really difficult to chip in another date! We've tried!

Now hold your horses. Before you close this email, we have to inform you that the Good News Train doesn't stop there. On top of the game's digital release announcement, you'll also be able to pre-order both the Standard and Collector's Editions in physical form [url=https://store.serenityforge.com/collections/read-only-memories]RIGHT HERE, RIGHT NOW[/url] for Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5. But wait, there’s more! Our good friends at Serenity Forge are also announcing Neurodiver tees featuring Rebecca Ryan’s stunning artwork you see above, AND a gorgeous reprint of 2064: Read Only Memories. [i]Phew![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/d9a792e62eea4b64335e37d8a7acc2f935b79e48.png[/img]
The Standard Edition will include a full manual and soundtrack download code, while the Collector's Edition will include a full color art book, holographic stickers, an acrylic charm of ES88, and your very own Neurodiver to take care of and love (in plush form only).

We'd like to thank you for all of your patience with us over the years with this project, and we're thrilled to finally reach the end of our long journey of building this world for you to experience.

The Long and Short of It:

[list]
[*] Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER launches on [b]May 16th[/b]
     [b]>[/b] For [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293910/Read_Only_Memories_NEURODIVER/]Steam[/url], Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox

[*] Pre-Orders for physical Standard and Collector's Editions, tees, and 2064 reprints are [url=https://store.serenityforge.com/collections/read-only-memories]available NOW[/url].

[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293910/Read_Only_Memories_NEURODIVER/]Wishlist us on Steam[/url] if you haven't already!

[*] Check out the demo, Pilot Memory, on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293910/Read_Only_Memories_NEURODIVER/]Steam[/url] now!
     [b]>[/b] This'll be updated with some newer graphics and VO in the full game!
[/list]
And that's it! Thank you so much again for your patience and we hope to see you in Neo-San Francisco on [b]May 16th[/b]!

- MidBoss

notes.title: Demo Updated
notes.content:
We just uploaded an update to the free demo of NEURODIVER: Read Only Memories (the sequel) that you can play right now. 

The latest build fixes a bunch of things that folks like you reported. Here are some of them 

[list]
[*] More responsive Memory Fragment Repair UI
[*] Dialogue grammar fixes for both English and Japanese
[*] Added new configuration options for sound, display and text to the Settings menu 
[*] Added new end screen
[*] Game no longer auto-quits when you finish the demo
[*] General bug fixes
[*] We also got this brilliant new cover art:
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing Kitsune Tails!
notes.content:
No, this is not [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293910/Read_Only_Memories_NEURODIVER/]NEURODIVER[/url], which we are still diligently working on, but we’d like to announce a delightful new game featuring classic platforming, magic & queer romance!

[previewyoutube=2XBSBUlc5Es;full][/previewyoutube]
In collaboration with another amazing queer game studio, [url=https://kitsunegames.com/]Kitsune Games[/url], the makers of the game MidBoss (coincidentally named, but not associated with us) and the even more famous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1258040/Super_Bernie_World/]Super Bernie World[/url], we’re proud to announce development of our upcoming title [url=https://kitsunegames.com/kitsunetails/]Kitsune Tails[/url], a platformer styled after beloved classics steeped in Japanese mythology and diverse relationships, coming to PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, as well as Windows and Linux via [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325260/Kitsune_Tails/]Steam[/url] and itch.io.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/4a82bde544214587d619dd74e6db57a81ca4dcbe.gif[/img]

Play as a young female [i]kitsune[/i], one of Inari’s fox-eared and bushy-tailed messengers, and embark on a hero’s journey that begins while delivering your first message. Experience a romantic encounter with a kindly sorceress who comes to your aid in a time of need. Explore the complicated relationship with your former mentor turned antagonist and uncover her reasons for sealing your love interest inside an elemental prison. Unlock powers that manifest as cute outfits to help you run, jump, and dash across five elemental worlds to save your love interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/e2deaa15275dbd66faa5a531998e60380eb80e05.gif[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Classic platforming action set in a land inspired by Japanese mythology
[*] Explore five elemental worlds and various haunted houses
[*] Learn new elemental powers and use them to find secrets and optional story content
[*] Unlock a bonus ending by fully exploring the relationships between characters
[*] Use cute outfits to power up, stomp around by stealing a giant boot from enemies
[*] Defeat your haughty former mentor and her foxy gang of minions
[*] Stomp on pangos to make them curl into a ball, pick them up, and kick them around
[*] Carry lights through haunted houses to reveal secret doors and ward off ghosts
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/748d370cc053e8610de7a8dd358d1e4e5619af13.gif[/img]

If you like what you see, you can find out more at kitsunetails.com or by visiting the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325260/Kitsune_Tails/]Steam store page[/url] (wishlist it!), and of course you can always stay up-to-date by following the journey on Twitter.

As always, be sure to keep your augmented eyes [url=https://twitter.com/midboss]on[/url] • [url=https://twitter.com/romadventure]our[/url] • [url=https://www.facebook.com/wearemidboss]social[/url] • [url=https://www.facebook.com/ROMAdventure]media[/url] for further updates!

Until next time!
—MidBoss
